values.note: Electric sites $37 a night; premium electric sites near the water $39; full hookups $50; the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) electric and full-hookup $33, premium electric $35. The non-electric and premium non-electric sites ($27 / $31) are tent-only, so they don't set the RV base. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Lake Loramie campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 37.00, Premium Electric 39.00, Full Hookup 50.00, Non-Electric 27.00 and Premium Non-Electric 31.00 with IsRVSite false and tent map icons); sites 001, 056 and 016 on Sat 2027-06-19 (37.00 / 50.00 / 39.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (33.00 / 33.00 / 35.00), Fee 6.50 + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-loramie-state-park-campground ('15 non-electric sites (Tent camping, only.)'), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (electric, premium electric and full-hookup sites list Electricity Hookup '50'; the 42 full-hookup sites list water and sewer hookups) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-loramie-state-park-campground ('42 sites with full hook-ups'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 156 web-bookable RV sites: 73 electric, 41 premium electric (near the water, electric only) and 42 full hookup (4 lakeside), almost all back-in pads of 45-50 ft, plus 3 pull-throughs of 50-70 ft; 14 more non-electric sites are tent-only. ODNR counts 120 electric (40 premium), 42 full-hookup and 15 non-electric sites. Several sites have courtesy boat tie-ups. Three ADA Cedar Cabins (no pets) sit inside the campground.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid 496 (170 units) + search/details (IsRVSite, Maximum Camping Unit Length 35-70, PullInTypeName) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-loramie-state-park-campground ('42 sites with full hook-ups, 4 are lakeside', '120 electric sites; 40 of which are premium sites. Premium sites are near the water and are electric only.', 'Several sites have courtesy boat tie-ups available.'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Restrooms include a washer and dryer. Miniature golf; canoe and kayak rentals for registered campers at the camp office.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-loramie-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets and a dump station', 'Restrooms include washer and dryer', 'Camp store', 'Canoe and kayak rentals (registered campers only)'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.' 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio. In the off-season (sampled November 2026 through mid-March 2027) only 19 units are sold: 14 electric sites (045-049, 087-091, 131-134, 152), premium electric 016 and four tent sites; the full loop reopens by mid-April.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/lake-loramie-state-park-campground (quoted) + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14) and search/grid 496 for 2026-11-17, 2026-12-08, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16 (19 units free, 151 blocked) and 2027-04-13, read 2026-10-30

note: Premium electric sites line Lake Loramie at the campground's north-east point (016-039) and the channel along its west and south sides (097-120); several sites have courtesy boat tie-ups. --Claude
summary: Fees changed: base 27 -> 37 (the $27/$31 non-electric sites are tent-only), high 27 -> 39 (premium electric), surcharges electric 10 / full_hookup 23 -> full_hookup 13, added off-peak $33/$35. Added 50-amp with water+sewer at full-hookup sites, 156 RV sites to 70 ft with 3 pull-throughs, showers/flush/dump/laundry/camp store, ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max, year-round reservations (19 units in winter). Booking reservable confirmed (was note-derived). Waterfront (lakefront) checked by plotting: consistent. Pin 62 m from the sites' centroid. Note reworded: dropped 'Reservable' (booking) and 'RV-capable', kept where the water sites are with their numbers.
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground and park pages give (937) 295-2011 (park office).

Waterfront (stored lakefront) plotted from ReserveOhio's site coordinates on imagery: the campground fills a peninsula with Lake Loramie's open water to the north and east and a ~50 m channel on the west and south. Premium electric sites 016-039 sit along the lake shore at the north-east point and 097-120 along the channel bank, most 10-30 m from the water; ODNR calls premium sites 'near the water' and four full-hookup sites (098-101 at the south tip) 'lakeside'. Consistent with lakefront; no change suggested.
